notes: After completing the quest, return to Gillie Groats to receive the additional quest rewards.

steps.text: Speak to Cassius by the Lumbridge pond, south of the windmill.
Speak to Gillie Groats in the Lumbridge cow field, just north of the entrance.
chat: 3. Can you share what makes your cows so productive?

steps.text: Speak to Seth Groats in the farmhouse by the chicken coop, north-west of the cow field.
Search the shelves on the southern wall for The groats principles.
Return the book to Cassius to receive a milk sample.
Drink the milk sample in front of Cassius, then speak to him again to receive another sample for Duke Horacio.
Speak to Duke Horacio upstairs in Lumbridge Castle about the permit.
Return to Gillie Groats and drink the milk sample when prompted.
Open the gate directly north-east of Gillie and defeat the bull.
Its normal attacks cannot kill you during the quest, but its special attacks can hit up to 19 and cannot be prayed against.
When it snorts, move two tiles to either side or one tile backwards.
When it growls, move two tiles to either side.
Speak to Gillie Groats about the bull.
Return to Cassius and confront him.
